_comment: Stockfish 19 at reduced strength. Stockfish maps UCI_Elo to its internal skill level (src/search.h: 'Skill 0..19 covers CCRL Blitz Elo from 1320 to 3190, approximately'); UCI_Elo 3139 = Skill Level 17, 3057 = 15, 2786 = 10. The 'ccrl' values are Stockfish's own approximate calibration, not CCRL-measured ratings. Run: gh workflow run ccrl-ladder.yml -f anchors_file=scripts/anchors-stockfish.json
